items.abstract_or_text: We congratulate Levent Alpöge and Tristan Buckmaster on their remarkable mathematical work. We (the researchers and the agents) did not see any of their work through any means until they released it publicly — in particular, no specific user data was accessed in order to solve this problem. items.abstract_or_text: We’re sharing a solution to the Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize Problem, one of the deepest problems at the frontier of mathematics. The proof was produced by a group of agents, using an OpenAI next-generation model significantly more capable than GPT-6 Astra. The problem concerns whether the description of smooth three-dimensional fluid motion modeled by the Navier-Stokes equations can break down. It has remained unresolved for roughly 90 years.

items.abstract_or_text: We have found stable singularity on 3D Euler! http://anima-ai.org/2026/09/07/stable-singularity-of-the-euler-equations-on-r3-without-forcing/ Our starting point is a physics-informed neural network (PINN) to come up with an approximate answer, and then to argue stability around that to complete the proof. The challenge so far has been that PINNs have not been successful in discovering singularities on the current problem. A common failure mode is PINNs converging to a trivial solution. We take special care to nudge our PINN to interesting regions through a combination of constraints, and we believe this is a novel way of making PINNs work for such hard optimization problems. We also carry out a detailed study of the transport field of our approximate profile, and show it has promising properties of local outgoing flow, essential for proving linear damping, which is an important ingredient of overall stability. We believe that such physics-informed and physics-centric AI are critical ingredients across many areas of research involving physical systems, and LLMs lack such physical grounding. We have been working on this problem for much of this year, and we just saw the announcement by Tristan on Euler with forcing. In contrast, we consider without forcing and use a PINN formulation. @Caltech

items.title: A single reference-energy outlier nearly eliminates Co–O chemistry from a generative model's training distribution
items.abstract_or_text: An element-resolved audit of 44,688 oxide structures generated by MatterGen under chemical-system conditioning revealed that the aggregate composition compliance (73.27% exact match) concealed a severe chemistry-specific failure. Cobalt was omitted from 71.27% of the structures requesting it, against 8.12 ± 3.28% for the other 19 requested elements, and 98.17% of the cobalt omissions removed cobalt alone. Cell size, cation substitutability, stability gain and a general training-frequency effect did not account for the anomaly. Tracing the failure upstream showed that only one of the 8,924 cobalt oxides in the public Alex-MP-20 reference set passed the stability filter. The deficit was traced to a single anomalous reference-energy entry distorting the Co–O convex hull; excluding it raises the number of training-eligible cobalt oxides from 1 to 2,499. Four independent DFT calculations and the current Materials Project value agree within 0.024 eV atom-1, whereas the value implied by the released file deviates from them by 6.26 eV atom-1. A pre-registered intervention experiment showed that neither removal of the stability condition nor stronger diffusion guidance normalised the blind spot. These results show how a single high-leverage reference-energy anomaly can be amplified through stability filtering into a training deficit at the scale of a chemical family. Two audits that detect this class of failure without retraining are presented, namely an element-resolved condition-fidelity audit and a reference-hull vertex audit.

items.abstract_zh: 对在化学体系条件约束下由 MatterGen 生成的 44,688 个氧化物结构进行元素分辨审计发现，汇总组成符合率（73.27% 精确匹配）掩盖了严重的化学特异性失败。请求含钴的结构中有 71.27% 缺失钴，而其余 19 种被请求元素的该比例为 8.12 ± 3.28%；98.17% 的钴缺失仅去除了钴本身。晶胞大小、阳离子可替代性、稳定性增益和一般训练频率效应均无法解释该异常。向上游追踪显示，公开 Alex-MP-20 参考集中的 8,924 个钴氧化物仅有 1 个通过稳定性筛选。该缺口可追溯至一个扭曲 Co–O 凸包的异常参考能量条目；排除该条目后，符合训练条件的钴氧化物数从 1 增至 2,499。4 项独立 DFT 计算和当前 Materials Project 数值在 0.024 eV atom-1 内一致，而发布文件所隐含的数值与其相差 6.26 eV atom-1。一项预注册干预实验显示，移除稳定性条件或加强扩散引导均未使该盲点恢复正常。这些结果表明，单个高杠杆参考能量异常可经稳定性筛选被放大为化学家族尺度的训练缺口。本文提出两种无需重新训练即可发现此类失败的审计方法，即元素分辨条件保真度审计和参考凸包顶点审计。

items.title: Reasoning Before Disposition: A Model-Agnostic Cannot-Miss Discipline for Quiet Emergencies and the Case for Deterministic Enforcement
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models now match clinicians on medical-knowledge benchmarks. Whether they can safely triage a patient message is a separate question, and the highest-consequence failure in triage is the emergency that never gets escalated. We tested two competing explanations for that failure. The first is sycophancy: the model defers to a patient who downplays a danger sign. The second is atypicality: the model reads an early, mild, or atypical presentation of a time-critical disease as benign. To isolate the effect of a model-agnostic cannot-miss discipline, we performed a prompt-level ablation on a fixed frontier model (Claude Opus 4.8), then replicated the same instruction-level intervention across eight models from two families (Claude Opus 4.8, Sonnet 5, Haiku 4.5, and Fable 5; Gemini 3.1 Pro-Preview, 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite, and 3.1 Flash-Lite) under a released harness, and released the whole apparatus as an open, model-agnostic evaluation suite. Minimization turned out to be harmless when danger is overt. Across 40 unambiguous emergencies rendered in five framings on Opus 4.8 (neutral, mild minimization, strong denial, third-party reassurance, and a benign distractor), sensitivity stayed at or above 97.5% in every arm and was flat across framings, and seven of the eight models held 97.5% to 100% on the neutral set (the eighth completed 13 of 40 stems, all escalated). Atypicality is where the hazard lives. Across 76 subtle or atypical emergencies, each adjudicated by a blinded, LLM-simulated three-physician panel and each mapped to a published guideline that names its cannot-miss diagnosis, the base model failed to escalate 13.2% (95% CI 7.3 to 22.6) to the top acuity tier; the governance prompt cut this to 3.9% (1.4 to 11.0; paired exact McNemar 7 to 0, p = 0.016; relative risk 0.30; number needed to treat 11). The effect sits in the harder half of the cohort (36 original stems: 22.2% to 8.3%, 5 to 0; 40 extension stems: 5.0% to 0%, 2 to 0), and its magnitude holds when the three stems an independent panel rated below emergency are excluded (9.6% to 2.7%, 5 to 0, p = 0.063). A one-line distillation reproduced most of the effect, showing that the underlying reasoning principle does not depend on proprietary prompt language. Its residual failures and weaker specificity behavior also show that portability of the principle is not equivalent to deterministic enforcement. The effect replicated in Spanish (27.8% to 11.1%, McNemar 6 to 0, p = 0.031). The effect replicated in a second, released harness on the same model, and then across eight models. In the eight-model replication, baseline under-triage ranged from 2.6% to 34.2% by model and elicitation. The same prompt text, unchanged, was applied above eight models from two vendors, three capability tiers, and two elicitation modes; under-triage fell in every cell where there was material hazard to remove, and no cell of any model gained a false emergency alarm. The identical governance prompt reduced it in seven of twelve model-by-elicitation cells, moved a single stem in three, and was neutral or reversed in the two cells already at the floor. With the stem as the unit of analysis, governance was favored on 19 stems and control on 5 across the eight reasoning-permitted models (sign test p = 0.007); pooled discordant pairs were 27 to 8 (p = 0.002) under forced-choice elicitation in the Claude family and 31 to 10 (p = 0.001; paired risk difference 3.5 points, 95% interval 1.5 to 5.7) under reasoning-permitted elicitation across both families. The misses concentrate: 42 of the 76 stems were never missed by any model in either arm, ten stems account for 71% of all baseline misses, and a handful of conditions (subacute endocarditis, early ectopic pregnancy, early urosepsis, mesenteric ischemia, early appendicitis) are missed by most models and resist most of the prompt's effect. On a 44-stem panel-adjudicated non-emergency cohort, the full prompt added zero escalations to EMERGENCY in any model under any elicitation (0 of 44 per cell; Wilson upper bound 8.0%), and it moved some ROUTINE stems to same-day URGENT (17 added against 2 removed across eight models, p < 0.001). Across more than 5,900 triage classifications, no emergency was ever routed home in any arm; the failure mode is uniformly EMERGENCY to URGENT. The prompt changed nothing on knowledge (MedQA 95.8% in both arms, 4 to 4 discordant), adversarial robustness, or medication-hazard detection, while raising named-guideline citation from 65.6% to 96.9% at roughly 2.3 times fewer output tokens; HealthBench fell 3.6 points on a single seed, concentrated in context-seeking and uncertainty-handling behaviors, and warrants follow-up. Elicitation mattered: forcing an immediate single-shot disposition raised baseline hazard by roughly ten percentage points in two of four Claude models, and the governance increment in the Claude family was largest under that elicitation. Quiet emergencies, defined here as early, mild, or atypical presentations of time-critical conditions, were the principal source of under-triage in this constructed cohort rather than overt emergencies accompanied by patient minimization. A prompt-level cannot-miss discipline reduced that hazard across a heterogeneous set of models without adding false emergency escalations in the primary specificity cohort. However, residual failures remained concentrated, stochastic, dependent on model choice and elicitation, and undefined when output could not be parsed. These findings show both the portability of the reasoning discipline and the limits of implementing it through instructions alone. MedCanon is presented as a hybrid clinical runtime with a deterministic safety spine designed to convert these distributional improvements into versioned, testable invariants. The runtime itself was not evaluated in this study. The Level 2 evaluation specified here is required before claims about its clinical safety effect, determinism, or auditability can be made. Ground truth came from LLM-simulated panels triangulated against an independent cross-family panel, published guideline anchors, and an externally authored vignette set; independent board-certified human adjudication is required before any clinical-deployment claim.

items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型如今已能在医学知识基准上与临床医生匹敌。它们能否安全地分诊患者消息是另一回事，而分诊中后果最严重的失败，是从未被升级处理的急症。我们检验了对此失败的两种相互竞争的解释。第一种是迎合性：模型顺从淡化危险信号的患者。第二种是非典型性：模型将时间敏感疾病的早期、轻微或非典型表现解读为良性。为分离模型无关的“不可漏诊”规则的效应，我们先在一个固定的前沿模型（Claude Opus 4.8）上进行了提示词层面的消融，随后在发布的测试框架下，将同一指令层面干预复制到来自两个家族的 8 个模型（Claude Opus 4.8、Sonnet 5、Haiku 4.5 和 Fable 5；Gemini 3.1 Pro-Preview、3.6 Flash、3.5 Flash-Lite 和 3.1 Flash-Lite），并将整套装置作为开放、模型无关的评测套件发布。在危险信号明显时，淡化并无害处。在 Opus 4.8 上以 5 种表述（中性、轻度淡化、强烈否认、第三方安慰和良性干扰项）呈现的 40 个无歧义急症中，每个组的敏感性均维持在 97.5% 或以上，且各表述之间持平；8 个模型中有 7 个在中性集合上维持 97.5% 至 100%（第 8 个完成了 40 个题干中的 13 个，均被升级）。风险出现在非典型性。对于 76 个细微或非典型急症，每个病例均由盲法、LLM 模拟的 3 名医师小组裁决，并映射至点明其不可漏诊诊断的已发表指南；基础模型有 13.2%（95% CI 7.3 至 22.6）的病例未被升级到最高紧急度层级，治理提示词将该比例降至 3.9%（1.4 至 11.0；配对精确 McNemar 7 比 0，p = 0.016；相对风险 0.30；治疗获益人数 11）。该效应位于队列中较困难的一半（36 个原始题干：22.2% 至 8.3%，5 比 0；40 个扩展题干：5.0% 至 0%，2 比 0）；当排除独立小组评为低于急症的 3 个题干后，效应幅度仍然存在（9.6% 至 2.7%，5 比 0，p = 0.063）。一句话蒸馏复现了大部分效应，表明其底层推理原则不依赖专有提示词措辞。其残余失败和较弱的特异性表现也说明，原则的可迁移性不等于确定性执行。该效应在西班牙语中得到复制（27.8% 至 11.1%，McNemar 6 比 0，p = 0.031），并在同一模型的第二个已发布测试框架中、继而在 8 个模型中得到复制。在 8 模型复制中，基线低分诊率按模型和诱导方式在 2.6% 至 34.2% 之间。完全相同的提示词文本被施用于两个供应商、三个能力层级和两种诱导模式中的 8 个模型；在存在实质性风险的每个单元中，低分诊均下降，且任何模型的任何单元均未新增假急症警报。同一治理提示词在 12 个模型—诱导单元中的 7 个降低了低分诊，在 3 个仅改变一个题干，在已经处于下限的 2 个中无效或反向。以题干为分析单位，在 8 个允许推理的模型中，治理在 19 个题干中占优、对照在 5 个中占优（符号检验 p = 0.007）；在 Claude 家族的强制选择诱导下，汇总不一致配对为 27 比 8（p = 0.002），在两个家族允许推理的诱导下为 31 比 10（p = 0.001；配对风险差 3.5 个百分点，95% 区间 1.5 至 5.7）。漏诊高度集中：76 个题干中有 42 个在任一组均未被任何模型漏诊，10 个题干占全部基线漏诊的 71%，少数病种（亚急性感染性心内膜炎、早期异位妊娠、早期尿源性脓毒症、肠系膜缺血、早期阑尾炎）被大多数模型漏诊，且对大多数提示词效应有抵抗。在一个由小组裁决的、含 44 个题干的非急症队列中，完整提示词在任何模型和任何诱导下均未增加升级至 EMERGENCY 的病例（每个单元 0/44；Wilson 上限 8.0%），但确实将部分 ROUTINE 题干移至当日 URGENT（8 个模型中新增 17 个、移除 2 个，p < 0.001）。在超过 5,900 次分诊分类中，任何组均未将急症送回家；失败模式一律为 EMERGENCY 至 URGENT。提示词没有改变知识水平（MedQA 均为 95.8%，4 比 4 个不一致）、对抗鲁棒性或药物危害检测，但将具名指南引用从 65.6% 提高至 96.9%，且输出 token 约减少 2.3 倍；HealthBench 在单个随机种子上下降 3.6 分，集中于寻求上下文和处理不确定性的行为，值得后续研究。诱导方式很重要：在 4 个 Claude 模型中的 2 个中，强制立即给出单次处置使基线风险提高约 10 个百分点；Claude 家族中的治理增量在该诱导下最大。此处定义为时间敏感疾病早期、轻微或非典型表现的“安静急症”，在这个构建性队列中是低分诊的主要来源，而非伴随患者淡化的明显急症。提示词层面的不可漏诊规则在异质模型集合中降低了该风险，且在主要特异性队列中没有增加假急症升级。然而，残余失败仍然集中、随机、依赖模型选择和诱导方式，并且在输出无法解析时未被定义。这些结果同时说明了该推理规则的可迁移性及仅通过指令实施它的局限。MedCanon 被提出为一种带有确定性安全骨架的混合临床运行时，旨在将这些分布性改进转化为可版本化、可检验的不变量。本研究并未评估该运行时本身。在可以对其临床安全效应、确定性或可审计性作出主张之前，需要开展此处规定的 Level 2 评估。真实标签来自 LLM 模拟小组，并与独立跨家族小组、已发表指南锚点和外部作者编写的病例集进行三角验证；在作出任何临床部署主张之前，仍需要独立的委员会认证人类专家裁决。

items.title: Democratizing Agentic Access to Bioinformatics and Biopharmaceutical Databases and Analyses with BioMCP-TS
items.abstract_or_text: Practitioners want to give AI agents direct access to biomedical databases and analyses, but today that means choosing between dependency-heavy skill packages, data-lookup-focused server tools, and closed vendor platforms. BioMCP-TS removes the choice: one open-source server that installs with a single pinned command and verifies its own setup. An agent working through BioMCP-TS can search and cross-reference 50+ bioinformatics, pharmaceutical, and patent databases (genes, variants, drugs, diseases, literature, clinical trials, patents, functional genomics, and structures) and, uniquely among open bioinformatics servers, run heavyweight analyses in-process as WebAssembly: Bioconductor differential expression and htslib genomics operations with no R installation, C toolchain, or containers on the host, plus read-only SQL over curated local databases. We demonstrate these strengths with seven practical cases spanning drug-target due diligence, translational intelligence, GWAS follow-up, dependency analysis, cohort genomics, and differential expression, ranging from a first federated lookup through target-disease landscapes to published-structure shortlists and reproducible RNA-seq results, each answered end-to-end within minutes. The server, recorded transcripts, and the full problem set are available at https://github.com/yeyuan98/biomcp-ts (npm: biomcp).
items.summary_zh: BioMCP-TS 将 50+ 生物信息、药物和专利数据库检索，与浏览器内 WebAssembly 分析整合到开源 MCP 服务器。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它提供了可安装、可自检和带记录转录本的代理工具链；其端到端主张仍主要来自 7 个演示案例。
items.abstract_zh: 研究人员希望让 AI 代理直接访问生物医学数据库和分析，但目前这意味着必须在依赖项繁重的技能包、以数据查询为中心的服务器工具和封闭供应商平台之间选择。BioMCP-TS 消除了这一取舍：它是一个开源服务器，只需一条固定版本命令即可安装并验证自身设置。通过 BioMCP-TS 工作的代理可以检索并交叉引用 50 多个生物信息学、制药和专利数据库（基因、变异、药物、疾病、文献、临床试验、专利、功能基因组学和结构）；并且，它在开放生物信息服务器中独有地能以 WebAssembly 在进程内运行重型分析：无需在主机安装 R、C 工具链或容器，即可运行 Bioconductor 差异表达和 htslib 基因组操作，以及针对整理后本地数据库的只读 SQL。我们通过 7 个实际案例展示这些优势，涵盖药物—靶点尽职调查、转化情报、GWAS 后续研究、依赖性分析、队列基因组学和差异表达；案例从首次联邦查询、靶点—疾病图谱到已发表结构候选清单和可复现 RNA-seq 结果，均在数分钟内端到端完成。服务器、记录的转录本和完整问题集可见于 https://github.com/yeyuan98/biomcp-ts（npm: biomcp）。

items.title: Hybrid Rule-Based and Machine Learning Classification of Military Working Dog Medical Problems Using SNOMED CT and the Veterinary Extension
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract The Master Problem List in the Department of War’s veterinary electronic health record combines structured SNOMED CTselections with unstructured free text, and the record system provides no automated surveillance capability. We developedan automated pipeline that maps Master Problem List entries recorded between January 1, 2018, and December 31, 2025,to standardized SNOMED CT concepts, combining multi-tier rule-based matching, SapBERT biomedical concept linking, andsupervised classification of entries no rule resolved. For 73,856 records (13,653 unique terms), the pipeline assigned 1 of 19Level 1 clinical categories to 93.7% of records, matching 80.0% through concept-based tiers and assigning the remainder byanatomical keyword. The SNOMED CT Veterinary Extension supplied 22.8% of matched concepts. For fully unmatched terms,term frequency-inverse document frequency features with logistic regression outperformed a neural network on biomedicalembeddings (80.0% and 76.4% top-1 accuracy) and a few-shot large language model (58.6%), and was deployed to categorizethem. A blinded panel of 9 veterinary specialists rating 384 stratified terms served as the reference standard, and pipelineagreement with expert consensus was 82.7% across the dataset. The framework closes a clinical-informatics capability gapand supports population-level health surveillance of military working dogs.
items.summary_zh: 混合规则、SapBERT 链接和监督分类流程为 73,856 条军犬兽医 EHR 问题记录分配了临床类别，并由 9 位专家盲法评审验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作提供了大规模真实世界兽医临床信息学的可量化基准；82.7% 的专家一致性也界定了自动监测的当前误差边界。
items.abstract_zh: 国防部兽医电子健康记录中的主问题清单结合了结构化 SNOMED CT 选择项和非结构化自由文本，而记录系统不具备自动监测能力。我们开发了一条自动化流程，将 2018 年 1 月 1 日至 2025 年 12 月 31 日记录的主问题清单条目映射至标准化 SNOMED CT 概念；该流程结合多层级规则匹配、SapBERT 生物医学概念链接，以及对未被任何规则解析条目的监督分类。对于 73,856 条记录（13,653 个唯一术语），该流程为 93.7% 的记录分配了 19 个一级临床类别之一，其中 80.0% 通过基于概念的层级匹配，其余通过解剖学关键词分配。SNOMED CT Veterinary Extension 提供了 22.8% 的匹配概念。对于完全未匹配的术语，词频—逆文档频率特征结合逻辑回归的表现优于基于生物医学嵌入的神经网络（top-1 准确率分别为 80.0% 和 76.4%）以及少样本大型语言模型（58.6%），并被部署用于类别划分。由 9 名兽医专科医师对 384 个分层抽样术语进行盲法评分的小组构成参考标准，流程与专家共识在整个数据集上的一致性为 82.7%。该框架弥补了临床信息学能力缺口，并支持对军用工作犬进行人群水平健康监测。
items.author_line: Knobbe M, Fakiyesi O, Frey J, Mullaney S

items.title: Capsid-specialized protein language models reveal higher-order viral architecture from sequence
items.abstract_or_text: Viral capsid proteins preserve information on higher-order shell architecture and deep evolutionary history, yet current capsid annotation relies predominantly on homology-based methods that have reduced sensitivity across highly divergent environmental sequences. Here we develop ESMCapsid, a capsid-specialized protein language model for remote capsid detection and architecture-aware representation learning. Screening 343 million representative metagenomic protein clusters revealed a large homology-dark capsid repertoire, with approximately 62% of candidates lacking matches to existing reference databases. Sparse autoencoder decomposition identified recurrent semantic motifs linking homology-dark proteins to known structural lineages, suggesting that interpretable higher-order architectural information can be recovered directly from capsid sequences at metagenomic scale. Mapping conserved motif cores onto resolved viral shells showed spatial clustering and restricted radial positions, indicating that ESMCapsid captures geometric constraints beyond sequence similarity alone. Together, our findings establish a sequence-based route to organize homology-dark viral diversity through conserved architectural principles, extending viral discovery beyond sequence homology.
items.summary_zh: ESMCapsid 以衣壳特化蛋白语言模型扫描 3.43 亿个代表性宏基因组蛋白簇，并识别出大量与现有参考库无匹配的候选衣壳蛋白。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将远缘衣壳发现、可解释表示和已解析病毒壳体映射相连接，为组织同源性暗区病毒多样性提供了可检验的序列路线。
items.abstract_zh: 病毒衣壳蛋白保留了高阶壳体架构和深层进化历史的信息，但当前衣壳注释主要依赖基于同源性的方法，而这些方法在高度分化的环境序列中敏感性降低。我们在此开发 ESMCapsid，一种用于远缘衣壳检测和架构感知表征学习的衣壳特化蛋白语言模型。对 3.43 亿个代表性宏基因组蛋白簇的筛选揭示了一个庞大的同源性暗区衣壳库，其中约 62% 的候选物在现有参考数据库中没有匹配。稀疏自编码器分解识别出重复出现的语义基序，将同源性暗区蛋白与已知结构谱系连接起来，提示可以在宏基因组尺度上直接从衣壳序列恢复可解释的高阶架构信息。将保守基序核心映射到已解析病毒壳体上显示出空间聚集和受限的径向位置，表明 ESMCapsid 捕获了超出序列相似性的几何约束。总体而言，我们的发现建立了一条通过保守架构原则组织同源性暗区病毒多样性的、基于序列的路线，并将病毒发现扩展到序列同源性之外。
items.author_line: Liu, S., Xia, S., Wang, H.

items.title: Beyond conventional sequence-based encoding: a generalized Machine Learning pipeline for oligonucleotide property prediction
items.abstract_or_text: The development of RNA-based therapeutics has significantly expanded the landscape of drug discovery by enabling precise modulation of gene expression. These approaches offer the potential to target previously "undruggable" genes, overcoming limitations inherent to traditional small molecule therapies. However, the rational design of effective oligonucleotides remains challenging partially due to the limitations of existing computational models which rely predominantly on sequence-based descriptors. These models are generally restricted to naturally occurring oligonucleotides and do not account for the chemical modifications that are essential for enhancing pharmacological and pharmacokinetic properties. To address this gap, we propose a novel chemical-based representation of oligonucleotides exploiting SMILES notation and molecular fingerprints, mainly exploited for small molecules. By applying them to both natural and chemically modified oligonucleotides, we trained machine learning (ML) models that achieved predictive performance comparable to state-of-the-art sequence-based approaches. Furthermore, we curated the first-ever collection of chemically modified oligonucleotides from patent literature, that allowed us to highlight the broad applicability and generalizability of our approach. This work lays the foundation for a unified pipeline capable of modeling both natural and modified oligonucleotides, advancing the computational design of next-generation RNA therapeutics.
items.summary_zh: 作者用 SMILES 与分子指纹为天然及化学修饰 oligonucleotides 建立统一表示，训练性质预测模型，并从专利文献整理化学修饰 oligonucleotides 集合。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 相较只以序列编码的方法，化学表示有望覆盖影响药代和药效的修饰，从而服务 RNA 药物设计。摘要仅报告与现有序列方法相当的性能，数据规模、任务边界和外部验证仍需从全文核查。
items.abstract_zh: RNA 疗法的发展通过实现对基因表达的精确调控，显著拓展了药物发现的版图。这些方法有望靶向此前“不可成药”的基因，克服传统小分子疗法固有的局限。然而，有效 oligonucleotides 的理性设计仍具挑战，部分原因在于现有计算模型主要依赖序列描述符。这些模型通常局限于天然 oligonucleotides，且未考虑对于增强药理和药代动力学性质至关重要的化学修饰。为填补这一空白，我们提出一种新颖的、基于化学的 oligonucleotides 表示方法，利用主要用于小分子的 SMILES 记法和分子指纹。通过将其用于天然及化学修饰的 oligonucleotides，我们训练出的机器学习（ML）模型取得了与最先进序列方法相当的预测性能。此外，我们从专利文献中整理了首个化学修饰 oligonucleotides 集合，从而凸显该方法的广泛适用性和泛化能力。这项工作为能够同时建模天然和修饰 oligonucleotides 的统一管线奠定基础，推进下一代 RNA 疗法的计算设计。
items.author_line: Margherita Lapillo, Maicol Bissaro, Iuni M. L. Trist, Enrico Gandini, Federico Sorana, Alfonso Pozzan

items.summary_zh: 作者观点：Roman Elizarov 认为 OpenAI 所称的 Navier–Stokes 突破属于纯数学进展，不会直接通向人工心脏、血栓预防或其他实际工程问题。

items.title: High-Throughput Experimentation Enables the C6-Functionalisation of 1H-Indazol-3-Amines as Antitubercular Agents
items.abstract_or_text: The development of novel antitubercular drugs targeting mycobacterial thioredoxin reductase (TrxR) has previously been hampered by the synthetic intractability of promising benzisothiazole-based inhibitors. Here, we identify 6-substituted 1H-indazol-3-amine as a bioisosteric scaffold that offers a comparable binding mode and improved synthetic accessibility. To address the lack of established protocols for the derivatisation of this scaffold at the C6 Position, we carried out a high-throughput experimentation (HTE) campaign with 984 individual reactions. Through parallel screening, the reaction condition space for Suzuki-Miyaura and Buchwald-Hartwig cross-couplings was systematically mapped, identifying a set of generally applicable conditions. Biochemical evaluation of the resulting library validated the bioisosteric design, yielding several derivatives with enhanced inhibitory activity against mycobacterial TrxR, including a micromolar inhibitor. Co-crystal structures of five derivatives could be obtained. This study establishes a synthetic foundation for exploring the 1H-indazol-3-amine scaffold and demonstrates how HTE can successfully address synthetic challenges in fragment-based drug discovery.
items.summary_zh: 以 984 个平行反应构成的高通量实验系统绘制 Suzuki–Miyaura 与 Buchwald–Hartwig 偶联的条件空间，并将 1H-indazol-3-amine 骨架用于分枝杆菌 TrxR 抑制剂开发；工作同时给出了生化活性和 5 个共晶结构验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是把合成可及性、系统条件筛选、靶标生化验证和结构证据连成闭环的药物化学工作。其结论目前仍限于 TrxR 抑制和先导化合物层面，尚不能外推为抗结核疗效。
items.abstract_zh: 针对分枝杆菌硫氧还蛋白还原酶（TrxR）的新型抗结核药物开发，先前一直受制于有前景的 benzisothiazole 类抑制剂在合成上的难处理性。本文鉴定出 6-取代 1H-indazol-3-amine 作为一种生物电子等排体骨架，其提供可比的结合模式和更好的合成可及性。为解决该骨架在 C6 位衍生化缺乏既有方案的问题，我们开展了包含 984 个独立反应的高通量实验（HTE）活动。通过平行筛选，系统绘制了 Suzuki-Miyaura 和 Buchwald-Hartwig 交叉偶联的反应条件空间，确定了一组具有普遍适用性的条件。对所得化合物库的生化评估验证了该生物电子等排体设计，得到若干对分枝杆菌 TrxR 抑制活性增强的衍生物，其中包括一种微摩尔级抑制剂。还获得了 5 个衍生物的共晶结构。本研究为探索 1H-indazol-3-amine 骨架奠定了合成基础，并展示了 HTE 如何能够成功解决基于片段药物发现中的合成挑战。
items.author_line: Philipp Janssen, Fabrice Becker, Vesa Krasniqi, Sophia Gethmann, Anna Junker, Oliver Koch

items.title: Operando Investigation of the Lithiation Mechanism in CsPbCl3 Perovskite
items.abstract_or_text: Metal halide perovskites offer a structurally responsive platform for lithium-ion battery components, however the interplay between structural transformation and electrochemical functionality remains poorly understood. Here, we investigate the lithiation mechanism in all-inorganic CsPbCl3 perovskite as a model system for resolving electrochemically driven phase reconstruction relevant to artificial solid electrolyte interphase concepts. Operando X-ray diffraction combined with electrochemical impedance spectroscopy, reveals that lithiation proceeds via a multistep pathway initiated by irreversible perovskite decomposition, resulting in formation of metallic Pb and mixed Cs–Li–Cl phases. Subsequently, reversible alloying reactions during the first cycle leads to the emergence of Li–Pb intermetallic compounds including LiPb and Li8Pb3. The evolution of diffraction features correlates with pronounced changes in the impedance response, revealing a transition from kinetically hindered conversion to more facile charge-transfer and diffusion-associated processes during alloying. Notably, no reconstruction of the perovskite framework is observed upon delithiation, confirming a conversion–alloying mechanism as the dominant charge-storage pathway. The in situ formation of Cs–Li–Cl phases coincides with marked changes in charge-transfer and diffusion-associated resistances, suggesting that the electrochemically generated chloride-rich products may contribute to the interfacial response of the reconstructed electrode. These results elucidate the lithium storage mechanism in halide perovskite-derived materials and highlight the role of decomposition-driven phase evolution in governing electrochemical performance.
items.summary_zh: 通过 operando XRD 与电化学阻抗谱，工作解析 CsPbCl3 钙钛矿嵌锂时先发生不可逆分解、继而进行 Pb–Li 可逆合金化的转换–合金化储锂机制。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 原位结构和阻抗证据明确了卤化物钙钛矿衍生电极中相重构与界面响应的联系，对人工 SEI 概念有价值。该研究是机制性模型体系工作，未证明器件层面的长期性能或实际应用优势。
items.abstract_zh: 金属卤化物钙钛矿为锂离子电池组件提供了一个结构响应性平台，但结构转变与电化学功能之间的相互作用仍知之甚少。本文研究全无机 CsPbCl3 钙钛矿的嵌锂机制，将其作为解析与人工固体电解质界面概念相关的电化学驱动相重构的模型体系。Operando X 射线衍射结合电化学阻抗谱表明，嵌锂经由多步路径进行，起始于不可逆钙钛矿分解，形成金属 Pb 和混合 Cs–Li–Cl 相。随后，首圈循环中的可逆合金化反应导致包括 LiPb 和 Li8Pb3 在内的 Li–Pb 金属间化合物出现。衍射特征的演变与阻抗响应的显著变化相关，揭示了在合金化期间从动力学受阻的转换到更容易的电荷转移和扩散相关过程的转变。值得注意的是，脱锂时没有观察到钙钛矿框架重构，证实转换–合金化机制是主导储能路径。Cs–Li–Cl 相的原位形成与电荷转移和扩散相关电阻的显著变化一致，提示电化学生成的富氯产物可能有助于重构电极的界面响应。这些结果阐明了卤化物钙钛矿衍生材料的锂储存机制，并强调分解驱动的相演变在决定电化学性能中的作用。

items.title: Integrated Raman Spectroscopy and Supervised Imaging for Label-Free Identification and Mapping of Oral Pathogens in Complex Biofilms
items.abstract_or_text: Although Raman spectroscopy has demonstrated excellent performance for the identification of isolated bacterial cells, its application to spatially resolved analysis of complex polymicrobial communities remains a major analytical challenge. Here, we present a transferable supervised Raman imaging workflow that integrates spontaneous Raman spectroscopy, confocal Raman microscopy, and PCA-LDA chemometric analysis for the label-free identification of clinically relevant oral bacteria. The proposed framework uses Raman spectra acquired from isolated bacterial cells to train a supervised classifier that is directly transferred to hyperspectral Raman images, enabling quantitative pixel-wise bacterial identification without fluorescent labels or molecular probes. The workflow was validated using four representative oral bacterial species (Streptococcus oralis, Actinomyces naeslundii, Fusobacterium nucleatum, and Porphyromonas gingivalis), spanning the ecological transition from oral health to periodontal disease. The PCA-LDA classifier achieved 99.8% accuracy for binary classification, maintained an overall accuracy of 93.8% after extension to four bacterial species, and successfully identified P. gingivalis at bacterial ratios as low as 1:6000 within mixed populations. Importantly, the classifier, trained exclusively on planktonic single-cell Raman spectra, was directly transferred to Raman images of mixed bacterial communities and increasingly complex biofilm models without retraining, achieving classification accuracies of approximately 98%. The Raman-based classification was independently validated by morphology-based segmentation and Gram staining. These results establish a scalable and transferable analytical framework for quantitative Raman imaging of polymicrobial communities. By combining supervised machine learning with hyperspectral Raman microscopy, the proposed workflow provides a versatile strategy for label-free bacterial identification and spatial mapping, representing an important step toward Raman-based precision microbiology and future optical diagnostics of oral infectious diseases.
items.summary_zh: 该工作将自发拉曼光谱、共聚焦拉曼显微镜和 PCA-LDA 结合，以孤立细胞光谱训练的分类器直接标注复杂混合群落和生物膜中的口腔菌，并以形态分割和革兰染色独立验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 跨越训练域而无需重训、在 1:6000 混合比例下识别 P. gingivalis，并有独立验证，使其成为较有说服力的无标记空间微生物分析路线。结果仅覆盖 4 种口腔菌和所测生物膜模型，临床诊断泛化仍待验证。
items.abstract_zh: 尽管拉曼光谱已显示出识别孤立细菌细胞的优异性能，但其用于复杂多微生物群落的空间分辨分析仍是一项重大分析挑战。本文提出一种可迁移的监督式拉曼成像工作流，将自发拉曼光谱、共聚焦拉曼显微镜和 PCA-LDA 化学计量分析整合，用于无标记识别具有临床意义的口腔细菌。该框架利用从孤立细菌细胞获得的拉曼光谱训练监督分类器，并将其直接迁移至高光谱拉曼图像，从而无需荧光标记或分子探针即可实现定量的逐像素细菌识别。该工作流以 4 种代表性口腔细菌验证，即 Streptococcus oralis、Actinomyces naeslundii、Fusobacterium nucleatum 和 Porphyromonas gingivalis，覆盖从口腔健康到牙周病的生态转变。PCA-LDA 分类器的二分类准确率达到 99.8%，扩展至 4 个细菌物种后总体准确率仍为 93.8%，并能在混合群体中细菌比例低至 1:6000 时成功识别 P. gingivalis。重要的是，该分类器仅以浮游单细胞拉曼光谱训练，无需重新训练即可直接迁移至混合细菌群落和复杂程度逐渐增加的生物膜模型的拉曼图像，分类准确率约为 98%。基于拉曼的分类还通过基于形态的分割和革兰染色进行了独立验证。这些结果建立了一种可扩展、可迁移的多微生物群落定量拉曼成像分析框架。通过将监督机器学习与高光谱拉曼显微镜结合，该工作流为无标记细菌识别和空间作图提供了通用途径，是迈向基于拉曼的精准微生物学及未来口腔感染性疾病光学诊断的重要一步。

items.title: Real Science Is Harder Than Benchmarks: Evaluating Advanced AI Frameworks on Published Studies. II. Antibody Properties, Lipid-RNA Interactions
items.abstract_or_text: Artificial Intelligence (AI) frameworks for automating scientific research have shown strong performance on benchmarks, but their utility for real-world industrial research remains insufficiently characterized. Extending the analysis presented in the first paper of this series, we evaluated the same five advanced AI research frameworks (Kosmos, K-Dense, ToolUniverse, BioAgents from bio.xyz, and the AI Scientist-v2 from Sakana AI) on two more projects of high practical importance for biopharmaceutical development: predicting antibody developability properties with the use of pretrained protein language model embeddings, and modeling non-covalent lipid-RNA interactions in lipid nanoparticles with all-atom molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. The AI frameworks again showed genuine strengths, including unprompted identification of subtle methodological issues, successful use of pretrained protein embeddings, and consistent reporting of p-values and confidence intervals often absent from the original papers. However, no framework approached the scope of the original studies, and severe failures and hallucinations were observed. Our results confirm and extend the conclusion of the first paper that real published research from pharmaceutical companies that we tried to reproduce proved to be considerably harder for current AI frameworks than standard benchmarks suggest.
items.summary_zh: 作者在抗体可开发性预测和 LNP 中 lipid-RNA 非共价相互作用全原子 MD 两项药物研发任务上，评估 Kosmos、K-Dense、ToolUniverse、BioAgents 与 AI Scientist-v2 五个科研 AI 框架的真实复现实用性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究将 AI 科研代理从基准成绩拉回到高复杂度、工业相关的可复现研究任务，报告了方法问题识别等长处，也记录严重失败与幻觉。结论基于两个项目和所选框架，不能概括为所有科研 AI 的能力上限。
items.abstract_zh: 用于自动化科学研究的人工智能（AI）框架在基准测试上表现强劲，但其在真实世界工业研究中的实用性仍缺乏充分刻画。作为本系列第一篇论文分析的延伸，我们在另外两个对生物制药开发具有高度实际重要性的项目上评估了同样的 5 个先进 AI 科研框架（Kosmos、K-Dense、ToolUniverse、来自 bio.xyz 的 BioAgents，以及来自 Sakana AI 的 AI Scientist-v2）：利用预训练蛋白语言模型嵌入预测抗体可开发性性质，以及用全原子分子动力学（MD）模拟脂质纳米颗粒中的非共价 lipid-RNA 相互作用。这些 AI 框架再次显示出真正的优势，包括未经提示便识别细微方法学问题、成功使用预训练蛋白嵌入，以及一致报告原始论文中经常缺失的 p 值和置信区间。然而，没有任何框架接近原始研究的范围，且观察到严重失败和幻觉。我们的结果确认并扩展了第一篇论文的结论：我们尝试复现的制药公司真实已发表研究，对当前 AI 框架而言比标准基准测试所显示的要困难得多。

items.title: Campylobacter jejuni Infection Is Associated With Cell-Cycle, Redox, and Metabolic Remodeling of Human Intestinal Epithelial Cells at Single-Cell Resolution
items.abstract_or_text: Campylobacter jejuni is the leading cause of bacterial enteric infections worldwide, including in the US. It is also a zoonotic pathogen that is transmitted by food and water, causing diarrhea and intestinal inflammation, and is responsible for high morbidity and mortality in young children, the elderly, and immunocompromised patients. During infection, C. jejuni profoundly perturbs intestinal epithelial physiology, leading to widespread mucosal damage and inflammatory response. However, the heterogeneity and coordination of host transcriptional responses remain incompletely defined. We performed single-cell RNA sequencing of Caco-2 intestinal epithelial cells from uninfected Control and C. jejuni-infected biological samples using 10x Genomics GEM-X Flex chemistry. Our dataset comprised 159,088 cells and 18,142 measured features. A Seurat workflow resolved 19 transcriptional states and revealed a highly reproducible condition-associated redistribution of clusters across biological replicates. Our study demonstrated that C. jejuni infection was associated with increased representation of G2/M-classified cells and coordinated induction of checkpoint and mitotic-spindle genes, including CDKN1A, WEE1, MAD2L1, BUB1B, PLK1, CDC20, CDK1, and UBE2C. Furthermore, ranked enrichment independently identified a C. jejuni-enriched Reactome mitotic spindle checkpoint program (NES ~1.67, FDR ~0.013), while Hallmark analysis identified strong TNF/NF-kB, hypoxia, G2M checkpoint, TGF-beta, glycolysis, apoptosis, p53, and mTORC1-associated programs. Infection was also associated with significantly decreased JDP2 and higher NOX1 and DUOX2 gene expression. Furthermore, scMetabolism/AUCell identified 20 KEGG metabolic pathways at FDR <0.05 in a balanced 10,000-cell analysis, with 12 lower and 8 higher in infection. Together, these data support a model in which C. jejuni dramatically restructures epithelial transcriptional states and is accompanied by mitotic-checkpoint, inflammatory/stress, redox, and metabolic remodeling.

items.abstract_zh: Campylobacter jejuni 是全球（包括美国）细菌性肠道感染的首要病因。它也是一种经食物和水传播的人畜共患病原体，可引起腹泻和肠道炎症，并在幼儿、老年人和免疫功能低下患者中造成高发病率和死亡率。感染期间，C. jejuni 深刻扰乱肠上皮生理，导致广泛的黏膜损伤和炎症反应。然而，宿主转录反应的异质性和协调性仍未得到充分界定。我们利用 10x Genomics GEM-X Flex 化学技术，对未感染对照和 C. jejuni 感染生物学样本中的 Caco-2 肠上皮细胞进行了单细胞 RNA 测序。我们的数据集包含 159,088 个细胞和 18,142 个测量特征。Seurat 工作流解析出 19 种转录状态，并揭示了在生物学重复间高度可重复的、与条件相关的簇重分布。研究显示，C. jejuni 感染与被归类为 G2/M 的细胞比例增加，以及检查点和有丝分裂纺锤体基因的协同诱导相关，包括 CDKN1A、WEE1、MAD2L1、BUB1B、PLK1、CDC20、CDK1 和 UBE2C。此外，排序富集分析独立识别出 C. jejuni 富集的 Reactome 有丝分裂纺锤体检查点程序（NES ~1.67，FDR ~0.013），而 Hallmark 分析识别出强烈的 TNF/NF-kB、缺氧、G2M 检查点、TGF-beta、糖酵解、凋亡、p53 和 mTORC1 相关程序。感染还与 JDP2 显著降低以及 NOX1 和 DUOX2 基因表达升高相关。此外，scMetabolism/AUCell 在平衡的 10,000 细胞分析中识别出 20 条 FDR <0.05 的 KEGG 代谢通路，其中感染组中 12 条较低、8 条较高。总体而言，这些数据支持这样一个模型：C. jejuni 显著重塑上皮细胞转录状态，并伴随有丝分裂检查点、炎症/应激、氧化还原和代谢重塑。

items.title: ∆-Machine Learning for LC-DFT-level Excitation Energies of Bacteriochlorophyll Molecules in a LH2 Complex
items.abstract_or_text: Bacteriochlorophyll (BChl) molecules are the key pigments in the light-harvesting complex 2 (LH2) of purple bacteria, driving solar energy conversion. During this process, fluctuations in excitation energies of the pigments at ultrafast timescales, modulated by the surrounding protein environment, govern the excitation dynamics within the complex. Because of the relatively large size of these molecules with 85 atoms and their complex electronic structure, these energy fluctuations have so far been estimated using semi-empirical methods or low-level time-dependent density functional theory (TD-DFT). In this work, we introduce a ∆-machine learning protocol to predict excitation energies at the computationally demanding long-range-corrected (LC) TD-DFT level within a quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics (QM/MM) framework, using a semi-empirical tight-binding analogue (TD-LC-DFTB) as a low-cost reference. Excitation energies for 7.2 million BChl geometries from trajectories of the LH2 complex of Rs. molischianum have been determined at the TD-LC-DFT level, both with and without taking the protein environment into account. Unexpectedly, environmental descriptors did not improve performance, so the final model relies solely on molecular descriptors. The resulting LC-DFT and machine-learned excitation energy fluctuations yield reorganization energies closer to experiment than those based on LC-DFTB. The transferability across BChl binding pockets within the protein is, however, limited.
items.summary_zh: 作者以 TD-LC-DFTB 为低成本参考，在 QM/MM 框架中训练 Δ-machine learning 预测 Rs. molischianum LH2 复合物 720 万个 BChl 构象的 LC TD-DFT 激发能，并得到更接近实验的重组能。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作将高精度激发态计算扩展到百万级蛋白环境构象，可用于研究天然光捕获中的能量涨落。最终模型并未从环境描述符获益，且在不同 BChl 结合口袋间的迁移性有限。
items.abstract_zh: 细菌叶绿素（BChl）分子是紫色细菌光捕获复合物 2（LH2）中的关键色素，驱动太阳能转换。在该过程中，受周围蛋白环境调制、发生在超快时间尺度的色素激发能涨落支配复合物内的激发动力学。由于这些分子相对较大、含有 85 个原子且电子结构复杂，此前这些能量涨落只能使用半经验方法或低水平含时密度泛函理论（TD-DFT）估算。本文引入一种 Δ-machine learning 方案，在量子力学/分子力学（QM/MM）框架中预测计算代价很高的长程校正（LC）TD-DFT 水平激发能，并以半经验紧束缚类似物（TD-LC-DFTB）作为低成本参考。我们确定了 Rs. molischianum 的 LH2 复合物轨迹中 720 万个 BChl 几何构型在 TD-LC-DFT 水平下的激发能，同时考察和不考察蛋白环境。出乎意料的是，环境描述符没有改善性能，因此最终模型仅依赖分子描述符。所得 LC-DFT 和机器学习激发能涨落给出的重组能比基于 LC-DFTB 的结果更接近实验。然而，该模型在蛋白质中不同 BChl 结合口袋之间的可迁移性有限。
items.author_line: Sayan Maity, Vivin Vinod, Peter Zaspel, Ulrich Kleinekathöfer

items.title: Condition-Aware and Leakage-Resistant Machine Learning of Short-Peptide Self-Assembly Across Bulk State and Supramolecular Morphology
items.abstract_or_text: Short-peptide self-assembly is governed jointly by molecular structure and experimental environment, yet many predictive workflows treat condition-specific observations as independent samples. Here, a source-audited dataset was reconstructed from PeptideMiner and SAPdb to evaluate bulk-state and supramolecular-morphology prediction under leakage-resistant validation. Peptide identity was defined from sequence,terminal modifications,non-terminal modifications,peptide-system annotations,and conjugate partners; experimental descriptors included concentration, pH, temperature, thermal history, incubation, and explicit solvent composition. A conventional random row split was shown to be strongly non-independent: 87.3% of test molecular identities had already appeared in training and 94.2% of test rows came from molecules represented in training.Accordingly,all primary claims were based on molecular-identity-grouped validation and permanently sealed holdouts containing previously unseen molecular systems. For hydrogel versus non-gel prediction, a tuned Random Forest achieved ROCAUC 0.977, PR-AUC 0.882, balanced accuracy 0.945, F1 0.880, and MCC 0.836 on 115 conditions from 20 unseen molecular identities. Solvent identity and composition formed the dominant transferable feature block,but analyses restricted to fully aqueous conditions demonstrated that non-solvent variables,particularly concentration,pH,temperature,and related processing descriptors,retained substantial predictive information. A harder three-class non-gel/hydrogel/organogel task yielded macro ROC-AUC 0.783 and MCC 0.247 on unseen molecules, with organic non-gelling conditions constituting the dominant error mode. For broad morphology, an Extra Trees classifier achieved macro ROC-AUC 0.980, macro PR-AUC 0.925, and MCC 0.665 on 59 conditions from 14 unseen molecular identities, although spherical/particulate morphology remained comparatively difficult.Fine-grained morphology prediction was not forced when independent class support proved insufficient for stable molecule grouped cross-validation. These results establish that reliable learning of short-peptide self-assembly requires explicit representation of experimental environment, source-level curation, and validation at the level of independent molecular systems rather than condition rows.
items.summary_zh: 工作从 PeptideMiner 和 SAPdb 重建来源可审计数据集，以分子身份分组和封存的未见分子测试集，评估短肽自组装的凝胶态与超分子形貌预测，明确揭示随机按行划分造成的信息泄漏。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它将实验环境显式纳入分子建模，并以更接近实际外推的验证方案报告性能，是小数据化学机器学习中处理重复条件记录的有益范例。独立分子数较少，三分类和细粒度形貌预测仍明显困难。
items.abstract_zh: 短肽自组装同时受分子结构和实验环境控制，但许多预测工作流将特定条件下的观测视为独立样本。本文从 PeptideMiner 和 SAPdb 重建了一个经过来源审计的数据集，在抗泄漏验证下评估体相状态和超分子形貌预测。肽身份由序列、末端修饰、非末端修饰、肽体系注释和缀合伙伴定义；实验描述符包括浓度、pH、温度、热历史、孵育和明确的溶剂组成。常规的随机按行划分被证明具有很强的非独立性：87.3% 的测试分子身份已在训练中出现，94.2% 的测试行来自训练中已有代表的分子。因此，所有主要结论均基于按分子身份分组的验证和包含此前未见分子体系的永久封存留出集。对于水凝胶与非凝胶预测，调优的 Random Forest 在来自 20 个未见分子身份的 115 个条件上达到 ROC-AUC 0.977、PR-AUC 0.882、平衡准确率 0.945、F1 0.880 和 MCC 0.836。溶剂身份和组成构成主要的可迁移特征块，但仅限完全水相条件的分析表明，非溶剂变量，尤其是浓度、pH、温度及相关加工描述符，仍保留了实质性预测信息。更困难的非凝胶/水凝胶/有机凝胶三分类任务在未见分子上得到宏平均 ROC-AUC 0.783 和 MCC 0.247，其中有机相非凝胶条件是主要错误模式。对于宽泛形貌，Extra Trees 分类器在来自 14 个未见分子身份的 59 个条件上达到宏平均 ROC-AUC 0.980、宏平均 PR-AUC 0.925 和 MCC 0.665，尽管球形/颗粒形貌仍相对困难。当独立类别支持不足以实现稳定的分子分组交叉验证时，研究没有强行进行细粒度形貌预测。这些结果表明，可靠学习短肽自组装需要显式表示实验环境、进行来源层面的整理，并在独立分子体系而非条件行的层面验证。

items.title: Robust Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning Improves Joint Predicted-Potency and Drug-Likeness Yield in EGFR Molecule Generation
items.abstract_or_text: Optimizing a molecular generator against a single activity-model estimate can reward structures for which that estimate is unreliable. We extended our published ChemBERTa–reinforcement-learning (RL) workflow for human epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) with scaffold-separated activity modeling, empirically calibrated lower scores, bounded chemistry rewards, and matched-seed evaluation. From ChEMBL 37, we curated 6,476 unique structures with Reference/unspecified biochemical EGFR IC50 measurements; 4,491, 680, and 1,305 structures were assigned to scaffold-disjoint training, calibration, and test sets. The random-forest reward model achieved a test mean absolute error of 0.610 pIC50 units and R2 = 0.615. Uniform or potency-enriched masked-language-model continuation was crossed with three RL rewards, with three seeds and 600 generation attempts per combination. The locked LCB-versus-mean-only comparison changed GNN potency-screen yield by +0.28 percentage points (95% descriptive t interval,-1.10 to +1.66) across three seed-cluster means. In the pipeline-level comparison with the published-form baseline, Robust-LCB increased the GNN joint-screen yield in all six matched blocks; averaged across the two MLM arms, the yield rose from 0.72% to 1.22%. Two structures passed the full RF–GNN consensus funnel. These results support a pipeline-level increase in joint predicted-potency and drug-like yield, while the incremental contribution of the lower-score term alone remains uncertain. These comparisons describe computational variability; activity estimates for generated molecules require biochemical testing.
items.summary_zh: 该研究在 ChemBERTa–RL EGFR 分子生成流程中引入支架分离活性建模、经验校准的下界分数和有界化学奖励，并通过匹配随机种子比较多目标稳健强化学习。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 作者区分了整体流程增益与下界评分项的独立贡献，并明确生成分子需经生化测试，方法学表述较克制。活性和成药性均为计算筛选指标，完整漏斗中只有 2 个结构通过，尚无实验确证。
items.abstract_zh: 针对单一活性模型估计优化分子生成器，可能会奖励那些该估计并不可靠的结构。我们将已发表的、用于人表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）的 ChemBERTa–强化学习（RL）工作流扩展为包含支架分离的活性建模、经验校准的下界分数、有界化学奖励和匹配随机种子评估。我们从 ChEMBL 37 整理出 6,476 个具有 Reference/未指明生化 EGFR IC50 测量值的独特结构；其中 4,491、680 和 1,305 个结构分别被分配至支架不重叠的训练、校准和测试集。随机森林奖励模型在测试集上的平均绝对误差为 0.610 pIC50 单位，R2 = 0.615。将均匀或富集效价的掩码语言模型续训与 3 种 RL 奖励交叉组合，每个组合使用 3 个随机种子和 600 次生成尝试。锁定的 LCB 与仅均值比较，在 3 个随机种子簇均值上使 GNN 效价筛选产率改变 +0.28 个百分点（95% 描述性 t 区间为 -1.10 至 +1.66）。在与已发表形式基线的流程级比较中，Robust-LCB 在全部 6 个匹配区组中提高了 GNN 联合筛选产率；在两个 MLM 分支上平均，产率从 0.72% 增至 1.22%。有 2 个结构通过完整的 RF–GNN 共识漏斗。这些结果支持流程层面预测效价和类药性联合产率的提高，而下界分数项单独的增量贡献仍不确定。这些比较描述的是计算变异性；生成分子的活性估计需要生化测试。

items.title: Carbon Nanotube-Induced Magnetic Shielding Effects on 129Xe NMR from Equivariant Neural Networks
items.abstract_or_text: Equivariant graph neural networks (EGNNs) have shown success in building efficient and accurate machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) for molecular dynamics (MD) and in enabling the prediction of nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) parameters in complex systems. In this work, EGNNs are used to fine-tune an atomistic foundation model, which serves as an MLIP for large-scale molecular dynamics simulations of xenon in carbon nanotubes. In addition, EGNNs are employed to develop a machine learning model for the 129 Xe NMR magnetic shielding tensor, σ , enabling its direct prediction from MLMD snapshots. Both models are data-efficient and remain accurate well beyond their training data. Using this dual-model framework, we show that xenon encapsulated in carbon nanotubes experiences a nanotube-induced, negative 129 Xe isotropic chemical shift that varies non-monotonically with nanotube diameter and depends further on temperature and Xe loading, establishing this dual-model approach as an efficient route to interpreting confinement-driven 129 Xe NMR response.
items.summary_zh: 研究以等变图神经网络微调原子级 foundation model 用作 Xe@碳纳米管大尺度 MD 的 MLIP，同时直接从 MLMD 快照预测 129Xe NMR 磁屏蔽张量。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 双模型把长时间尺度限域动力学与 NMR 可观测量连接起来，揭示管径、温度和 Xe 装载量共同影响的非单调化学位移。摘要未提供独立实验验证或定量误差，模型在训练域之外的准确性仍需审查。
items.abstract_zh: 等变图神经网络（EGNNs）已显示出在构建高效、准确的机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）以开展分子动力学（MD）以及预测复杂体系核磁共振（NMR）参数方面的成功。本文中，EGNNs 被用于微调一个原子级 foundation model，将其作为碳纳米管中氙的大尺度分子动力学模拟的 MLIP。此外，EGNNs 被用于开发 129 Xe NMR 磁屏蔽张量 σ 的机器学习模型，使其能够从 MLMD 快照中直接预测。这两个模型均具有数据效率，并且在远超其训练数据的范围内仍保持准确。利用这一双模型框架，我们显示被封装在碳纳米管中的氙会经历由碳纳米管诱导的负 129 Xe 各向同性化学位移；该位移随碳纳米管直径呈非单调变化，并进一步取决于温度和 Xe 装载量，从而确立这一双模型方法是解释限域驱动的 129 Xe NMR 响应的高效路径。
items.author_line: Ouail Zakary, Tiia Jacklin, Perttu Lantto

items.title: Multimodal profiling establishes ovarian fibrosis as a measurable and targetable hallmark of human reproductive aging
items.abstract_or_text: ABSTRACT Ovarian aging underpins infertility, systemic morbidity, and mortality in women. Stromal fibrosis is implicated in ovarian aging but has not been defined in the human ovary in situ. We integrated shear wave elastography (SWE), extracellular matrix (ECM) neoepitope fingerprinting, and singlecell RNA sequencing of follicular fluid aspirates within the same individual to comprehensively profile ovarian fibrosis. In an age-stratified cohort ( 37 years; N=32), age predicted ovarian stiffness, while mean stiffness was independently associated with reduced oocyte yield and follicular efficiency. ECM profiling revealed a dynamic fibrotic index favoring formation over degradation products. Single-cell transcriptomics demonstrated an age-associated fibroinflammatory stromal program enriched in pro-fibrotic pathways with stromal-immune crosstalk. In a larger validation cohort (25-45 years; N=100), age was similarly associated with ovarian stiffness. Thus, ovarian fibrosis is a quantifiable hallmark of human reproductive aging and represents a robust potential non-invasive biomarker and target for therapeutic intervention.
items.summary_zh: 同一受试者内整合剪切波弹性成像、ECM neoepitope 指纹和单细胞 RNA 测序，将卵巢纤维化与人类生殖衰老的多个测量指标关联起来。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 发现队列 N=32 和验证队列 N=100 使非侵入性标志物假说更具可检验性，但观察性关联尚不能证明纤维化是衰老或不孕的致因。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要：卵巢衰老是女性不孕、全身性发病和死亡的基础。基质纤维化被认为与卵巢衰老有关，但尚未在原位人类卵巢中得到界定。我们在同一受试者内整合剪切波弹性成像（SWE）、细胞外基质（ECM）neoepitope 指纹分析和卵泡液抽吸物的单细胞 RNA 测序，以全面刻画卵巢纤维化。在年龄分层队列（<37 岁与 ≥37 岁；N=32）中，年龄可预测卵巢硬度，而平均硬度与较低的卵母细胞产量和卵泡效率独立相关。ECM 分析揭示了偏向形成产物而非降解产物的动态纤维化指数。单细胞转录组学显示出与年龄相关的纤维炎症性基质程序，其中富集促纤维化通路以及基质—免疫串扰。在更大的验证队列（25–45 岁；N=100）中，年龄同样与卵巢硬度相关。因此，卵巢纤维化是人类生殖衰老中可量化的标志，并代表一种稳健的潜在非侵入性生物标志物和治疗干预靶点。

items.title: PSMA PET SUVmax Adds Information Beyond Conventional Risk Indices in Localized Prostate Cancer: A Prospective Lesion-Level Radiopathologic Study
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Prostate-specific membrane antigen (PSMA) positron emission tomography (PET) is increasingly used to characterize newly diagnosed prostate cancer on the assumption that uptake highlights aggressive disease. However, maximum standardized uptake value (SUVmax) varies widely across localized tumors. Recent genomic assessments have suggested SUVmax reflects tumor biology even when accounting for other tumor indices. Here, we examined highly annotated pathologic, imaging and clinical correlates of intraprostatic SUVmax at the level of individual tumor foci in a prospective multimodal cohort. Methods: Exploratory lesion-level analysis of the radical prostatectomy arm of a single-center prospective diagnostic-accuracy trial (NCT04461509). Patients underwent simultaneous 18F-DCFPyL PSMA PET, multiparametric magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and high-resolution MRI before prostatectomy, with central blinded pathology and imaging review. Grade Group (GG) [≥]2 foci measuring [≥]10 mm were eligible. The primary outcome was focus-level SUVmax. Correlates spanning histology, tumor microenvironment, MRI and clinical indices were examined by Spearman correlation and rank-based group comparison, followed by separate linear regressions of log(1+SUVmax) each adjusted for GG and tumor size. A digital-pathology sensitivity analysis quantified immune, stromal and tumor pixel-area fractions on hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) sections from a subset of foci using a trained QuPath classifier. Results: Twenty-seven patients contributed 34 tumor foci, of which 21 (61.8%) were GG2. Median SUVmax was 5.7 (interquartile range [IQR] 3.9 - 12.1; range 0.0 - 57.9). SUVmax rose across the cribriform/intraductal carcinoma (Crib/IDC) gradient (median 3.9, 4.8 and 10.2 for absent, focal and extensive; p = 0.010), correlated with % Gleason pattern 4 ({rho} = +0.47, p = 0.005) and correlated inversely with stromal content ({rho} = - 0.40, p = 0.020). Grade Group (p = 0.115), Prostate Imaging Reporting and Data System (PI-RADS) 4 versus 5 (p = 0.705), standard apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) ({rho} = - 0.27, p = 0.130), baseline prostate-specific antigen (PSA) ({rho} = +0.04, p = 0.816) and PSA density ({rho} = - 0.02, p = 0.918) were not associated with SUVmax. In separate models of log(1+SUVmax) adjusted for Grade Group and tumor size, % Gleason pattern 4 remained associated with uptake (standardized {beta} = +0.76, 95% CI +0.11 to +1.41), Crib/IDC ({beta} = +0.36, - 0.03 to +0.74), and stromal content ({beta} = - 0.30, - 0.62 to +0.02). On 18 slides re-quantified by pixel classifier, no pixel-based compartment fraction correlated with SUVmax (immune {rho} = - 0.06, stroma {rho} = +0.02, tumor {rho} = - 0.04; all p > 0.5). Conclusions: In this prospective lesion-level cohort, intraprostatic PSMA SUVmax was associated with increased Gleason pattern 4 and cribriform/intraductal burden but not with other common risk indices. SUVmax therefore appears to carry information additive to conventional risk factors. Further investigations examining the tumor biology that reflects SUVmax are warranted.
items.summary_zh: 单中心前瞻性队列的病灶水平分析发现，局限性前列腺癌的 PSMA PET SUVmax 与 Gleason pattern 4 和 Crib/IDC 负担相关。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 同时进行 PET、MRI、中心盲法病理和数字病理，为影像—病理关联提供了较强设计；27 例患者和探索性分析不支持立即改变临床风险分层。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：前列腺特异性膜抗原（PSMA）正电子发射断层扫描（PET）日益用于表征新诊断前列腺癌，其假设是摄取可标识侵袭性疾病。然而，最大标准化摄取值（SUVmax）在局限性肿瘤间差异很大。近期基因组评估提示，即使考虑其他肿瘤指标，SUVmax 仍可反映肿瘤生物学。在此，我们在一个前瞻性多模态队列中，于单个肿瘤病灶水平考察了前列腺内 SUVmax 的高度注释病理、影像和临床相关因素。方法：对一项单中心前瞻性诊断准确性试验（NCT04461509）根治性前列腺切除术组进行探索性病灶水平分析。患者在前列腺切除术前接受同步 18F-DCFPyL PSMA PET、多参数磁共振成像（MRI）和高分辨率 MRI，并进行中心盲法病理和影像审阅。符合条件的是 Grade Group（GG）≥2 且直径 ≥10 mm 的病灶。主要结局是病灶水平 SUVmax。采用 Spearman 相关和基于秩的组间比较考察涵盖组织学、肿瘤微环境、MRI 和临床指标的相关因素，随后分别建立对 GG 和肿瘤大小校正的 log(1+SUVmax) 线性回归。数字病理敏感性分析使用训练好的 QuPath 分类器，量化一个病灶子集中苏木精—伊红（H&E）切片的免疫、基质和肿瘤像素面积比例。结果：27 名患者贡献 34 个肿瘤病灶，其中 21 个（61.8%）为 GG2。SUVmax 中位数为 5.7（四分位距 [IQR] 3.9–12.1；范围 0.0–57.9）。SUVmax 随筛状/导管内癌（Crib/IDC）梯度升高（缺失、局灶和广泛时的中位数分别为 3.9、4.8 和 10.2；p = 0.010），与 Gleason pattern 4 百分比正相关（ρ = +0.47，p = 0.005），并与基质含量负相关（ρ = -0.40，p = 0.020）。Grade Group（p = 0.115）、前列腺影像报告和数据系统（PI-RADS）4 相对于 5（p = 0.705）、标准表观扩散系数（ADC）（ρ = -0.27，p = 0.130）、基线前列腺特异性抗原（PSA）（ρ = +0.04，p = 0.816）和 PSA 密度（ρ = -0.02，p = 0.918）均与 SUVmax 无关。在分别对 Grade Group 和肿瘤大小校正的 log(1+SUVmax) 模型中，Gleason pattern 4 百分比仍与摄取相关（标准化 β = +0.76，95% CI +0.11 至 +1.41），Crib/IDC 的 β = +0.36（-0.03 至 +0.74），基质含量的 β = -0.30（-0.62 至 +0.02）。在经像素分类器重新量化的 18 张切片中，没有基于像素的区室比例与 SUVmax 相关（免疫 ρ = -0.06，基质 ρ = +0.02，肿瘤 ρ = -0.04；均 p > 0.5）。结论：在这个前瞻性病灶水平队列中，前列腺内 PSMA SUVmax 与较高 Gleason pattern 4 和筛状/导管内负担相关，但与其他常用风险指标无关。因此，SUVmax 似乎携带超出传统风险因素的信息。仍需进一步研究检验反映 SUVmax 的肿瘤生物学。
items.author_line: Motchoffo Simo, G., Movva, P., Seo, J., Shou, B., Vega, D., Hagens, T., Norris, E. C., Luthringer, D. J., D'Agnolo, A., Sung, K. H., Calais, J., Brisbane, W. G., Reiter, R. E., Daskivich, T. J., Li, D., Saouaf, R., Kim, H. L., Weiner, A. B.

items.title: CampChem: Rubric-Grounded Adaptive Campaigns for Multi-Round Organic Synthesis with Residual Spectral Observation
items.abstract_or_text: Organic synthesis is a multi-round campaign, not a one-shot SMILES completion: a failed solvent, a poisoned catalyst, or leftover starting-material peaks in the 1H NMR force the chemist to revise conditions and try again. Tool-using chemistry agents and condition classifiers still emit a single recipe and then stop. We propose CampChem, an adaptive campaign agent built on a chemistry-instruction LLM. A longitudinal campaign adaptive planner (LCAP) keeps a short memory of failed condition slots and peak signatures and decodes the next catalyst/solvent/reagent tuple under a mask. Chemistry rubric-as-judge reinforcement learning (Chem-RaJ) scores stoichiometry, hazard compatibility, slot completeness, and spectral consistency instead of using a free-form LLM judge. A residual spectral booster (RSB) injects a permutation-invariant peak-set residual when NMR is available and gates to zero otherwise. On SMolInstruct, CampChem reaches 67.1% forward-synthesis and 36.1% retrosynthesis Top-1 exact match with a Mistral-7B LoRA backbone. On USPTO-Condition it attains 0.2940 overall Top-1, and on AutoLabs Experiment 5 it raises protocol F1 from 0.75 to 0.81. Ablations show that Chem-RaJ carries most of the spectrum-free gain, LCAP matters once a prior tuple has been rejected, and RSB contributes mainly on simulated NMR revision.
items.summary_zh: CampChem 将化学指令 LLM 扩展为可根据失败条件和 NMR 残余峰进行多轮修订的合成活动代理，并以规则驱动的强化学习约束化学计量、危险相容性、槽位完整性和光谱一致性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把“给出一次配方”的合成预测推进到可保留失败记忆并迭代决策的设定，且提供消融与多个基准结果。增益主要来自无光谱场景的 Chem-RaJ，RSB 的效益主要见于模拟 NMR 修订，尚未证明真实实验室的闭环成功率。
items.abstract_zh: 有机合成是一项多轮活动，而不是一次性的 SMILES 补全：失效的溶剂、失活的催化剂或 1H NMR 中残留的起始物峰都会迫使化学家修订条件并再次尝试。使用工具的化学代理和条件分类器仍然只输出一份配方，随后便停止。我们提出 CampChem：一种建立在化学指令 LLM 之上的自适应活动代理。纵向活动自适应规划器（LCAP）保留对失败条件槽位和峰特征的短期记忆，并在掩码约束下解码下一个催化剂/溶剂/试剂元组。化学规则即评判强化学习（Chem-RaJ）对化学计量、危险相容性、槽位完整性和光谱一致性评分，而非采用自由形式的 LLM 评判。残余光谱增强器（RSB）在 NMR 可用时注入置换不变的峰集残差信号，否则将其门控为零。在 SMolInstruct 上，使用 Mistral-7B LoRA 骨干的 CampChem 达到 67.1% 的正向合成和 36.1% 的逆合成 Top-1 精确匹配率。在 USPTO-Condition 上，其总体 Top-1 为 0.2940；在 AutoLabs Experiment 5 上，其将方案 F1 从 0.75 提高至 0.81。消融实验表明，Chem-RaJ 承担了大部分无光谱条件下的增益；一旦先前元组被拒绝，LCAP 就变得重要；而 RSB 的贡献主要体现在模拟 NMR 修订上。

items.title: De Novo Linear Peptides as Potential Recognition Elements and/or Aggregation Modulators of Amyloid-β42 in Alzheimer’s Disease
items.abstract_or_text: The development of deep learning algorithms for de novo protein design has opened the way for novel in silico strategies to develop peptide binders targeting protein aggregation implicated in neurodegenerative diseases. When combined with molecular simulations, these approaches provide a promising framework for investigating protein-peptide recognition and its impact on aggregation. Herein, we studied, through molecular dynamics, four de novo peptides of sizes ranging between 7 and 15 residues, generated with RFdiffusion, combined with ProteinMPNN and AlphaFold, using different constrained sequences of the Aβ42 peptide and a common hotspot region (residues 16-22). The shorter peptides formed cross-β sheet structures with the hotspot sequence, whereas the longer peptides adopted α-helical conformations. The hotspot sequence in trans and the segment Aβ42(16-20) linked to an hexalysine sequence were also investigated. Aβ42 was modeled using CHARMM36m (C36m) and AMBER99SB-DISP force fields, with the latter showing an aggregation propensity comparable to C36m under 8 M urea denaturing conditions. The peptides’ potential to modulate aggregation was assessed for C36m Aβ42 model tetramers at 1:1 peptide-to-monomer ratios. Although none of the peptides prevented the formation of all possible oligomeric species (i.e., dimer, trimer, and tetramer), several, selectively inhibited or delayed tetramer formation within the simulation timescale, resulting in less compact assemblies. The underlying mechanisms differed among peptides, with some altering intermolecular β-sheet organization through persistent interactions with the C-terminal region and others influencing tetramer formation with limited participation in βsheet interactions. The behavior of the peptides 16-22 (KLVFFAE) and the 16-20-KKKKKK closely reproduced experimental observations. At high temperatures none of the peptides precluded tetramerization, suggesting that enhanced hydrophobic interactions outweigh peptide-mediated inhibition. Notably, charged peptides showed the strongest effects on tetramer formation, indicating an important role for electrostatic interactions in inhibiting Aβ42 aggregation.
items.summary_zh: 研究使用 RFdiffusion、ProteinMPNN 与 AlphaFold 生成 4 条 7–15 残基 de novo 肽，并借助分子动力学考察其与 Aβ42 热点的识别和对模型四聚体聚集的调节。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它为以蛋白设计工具寻找聚集调节肽提供了具体的结构与动力学假设，并报告了与已有实验观察一致的对照肽行为。主要证据来自有限时间尺度的模拟；没有任何候选阻止全部低聚体形成，也未给出新肽的实验效应。
items.abstract_zh: 用于从头蛋白设计的深度学习算法的发展，为开发靶向神经退行性疾病相关蛋白聚集的肽结合物提供了新的计算策略。与分子模拟结合时，这些方法为研究蛋白-肽识别及其对聚集的影响提供了有前景的框架。本文通过分子动力学研究了 4 条长度介于 7 至 15 个残基的 de novo 肽；这些肽由 RFdiffusion 结合 ProteinMPNN 和 AlphaFold 生成，使用 Aβ42 肽的不同受约束序列以及一个共同热点区域（残基 16-22）。较短肽与热点序列形成 cross-β 片层结构，而较长肽采取 α 螺旋构象。研究还考察了 trans 中的热点序列，以及连接至六赖氨酸序列的 Aβ42(16-20) 片段。Aβ42 使用 CHARMM36m（C36m）和 AMBER99SB-DISP 力场建模；后者在 8 M urea 变性条件下显示出与 C36m 相当的聚集倾向。在 1:1 肽与单体比例下，针对 C36m Aβ42 模型四聚体评估了肽调节聚集的潜力。尽管没有任何肽能阻止所有可能低聚物物种（即二聚体、三聚体和四聚体）的形成，但若干肽在模拟时间尺度内选择性抑制或延迟了四聚体形成，得到更不紧密的组装体。各肽的内在机制不同：有些通过与 C 末端区域持续相互作用改变分子间 β 片层组织；另一些则在有限参与 βsheet 相互作用的情况下影响四聚体形成。肽 16-22（KLVFFAE）和 16-20-KKKKKK 的行为与实验观察高度一致。在高温下，没有任何肽阻止四聚化，表明增强的疏水相互作用超过了肽介导的抑制。值得注意的是，带电肽对四聚体形成的影响最强，说明静电相互作用在抑制 Aβ42 聚集中具有重要作用。

items.title: Venetoclax-based Therapy Improves Outcomes across the Evolving Biology of t(11;14) Multiple Myeloma
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Translocation t(11;14) defines a biologically distinct subset of multiple myeloma (MM) enriched for BCL2 dependency. Treatment with venetoclax, selective BCL2 inhibitor, has shown varied responses in clinical trials and retrospective cohorts. Efficacy of venetoclax-based combination therapies and optimal timing of treatment in t(11;14) MM patients remain incompletely characterized. Methods: We have compared the overall survival of t(11;14) MM patients who received Venetoclax (N = 97) at any moment in time, to those who never did (N =284), in the largest retrospective cohort (N = 381) reported to date. We used longitudinal fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) to assess cytogenetic evolution and genomic complexity. We performed transcriptomic profiling of CD138 enriched tumors using RNA sequencing in a subset of samples and gene expression signatures (UAMS/HALLMARKS) were used to define molecular subtypes. Ex vivo drug sensitivity assays integrated with paired RNA sequencing were used to identify subtype specific therapeutic vulnerabilities and rational venetoclax based combination strategies. Results: Venetoclax exposure was associated with an improvement of median overall survival by nearly four years compared to non VEN exposed patients (p = 0.0003). Longitudinal cytogenetic analysis demonstrated stability of the primary t(11;14) translocation over time, while secondary abnormalities tend to accumulate, including those harboring high-risk secondary cytogenetic abnormalities such as del13q, amp/gain1q21, del17p, and del1p, resulting in increasing genomic complexity with disease progression. Transcriptomic analyses identified selective enrichment of CD1/CD2 signature (associated with t(11;14) NDMM) by single sample gene set enrichment analysis as a marker of prolonged progression free survival. However, patients with more than five prior lines of therapy were enriched for transcriptionally complex biology characterized by CD1/CD2 with either proliferative/hypermetabolic or inflammatory transcriptional programming which were associated with inferior outcomes with VEN based treatment. Ex vivo drug sensitivity profiling revealed subtype specific vulnerabilities, identifying daratumumab, lenalidomide, ixazomib, and panobinostat as rational partners for venetoclax depending on transcriptional context. Conclusion: Venetoclax-based therapy significantly improved overall survival in t(11;14) MM. Clinical benefit, defined by improved progression free survival, was greatest when venetoclax was administered earlier, preceding the emergence of transcriptomic reprogramming that reduces BCL2 dependency. These findings support transcriptomic biomarker guided, subtype specific venetoclax based treatment strategies to optimize outcomes in patients with t(11;14) MM.
items.summary_zh: 381 例 t(11;14) 多发性骨髓瘤回顾性队列中，接受 Venetoclax 的患者总体生存期更长；纵向 FISH、RNA-seq 和 ex vivo 药敏描绘了疾病演化相关的异质性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 队列规模和配对分子分析使其成为 Venetoclax 分层治疗的重要线索，但暴露并非随机分配，不能从该回顾性关联推断治疗因果获益。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：易位 t(11;14) 界定了多发性骨髓瘤（MM）的一个生物学上不同的亚群，该亚群富集 BCL2 依赖性。选择性 BCL2 抑制剂 Venetoclax 治疗在临床试验和回顾性队列中显示出不同反应。t(11;14) MM 患者中，Venetoclax 联合治疗的疗效和最佳治疗时机仍未得到充分表征。方法：我们在迄今报告的最大回顾性队列（N = 381）中，比较了任一时间接受 Venetoclax（N = 97）的 t(11;14) MM 患者与从未接受该药患者（N = 284）的总体生存期。我们使用纵向荧光原位杂交（FISH）评估细胞遗传学演化和基因组复杂性。我们在一个样本子集中对 CD138 富集肿瘤进行 RNA 测序转录组分析，并使用基因表达特征（UAMS/HALLMARKS）定义分子亚型。将 ex vivo 药物敏感性测定与配对 RNA 测序整合，用于识别亚型特异性治疗脆弱性和合理的 Venetoclax 联合策略。结果：与未暴露于 VEN 的患者相比，Venetoclax 暴露与中位总体生存期近 4 年的改善相关（p = 0.0003）。纵向细胞遗传学分析显示，主要 t(11;14) 易位随时间稳定，而继发异常倾向于累积，包括携带高危继发细胞遗传异常的 del13q、amp/gain1q21、del17p 和 del1p，随疾病进展导致基因组复杂性增加。转录组分析通过单样本基因集富集分析，识别出 CD1/CD2 特征的选择性富集（与 t(11;14) 新诊断 MM 相关）是无进展生存期延长的标志。然而，既往接受超过 5 线治疗的患者富集于转录组复杂生物学，其特征为 CD1/CD2 伴增殖/高代谢或炎症性转录编程；这些特征与基于 VEN 治疗的较差结局相关。ex vivo 药物敏感性谱揭示了亚型特异性脆弱性，依据转录背景识别出 daratumumab、lenalidomide、ixazomib 和 panobinostat 为 Venetoclax 的合理联合伙伴。结论：基于 Venetoclax 的治疗在 t(11;14) MM 中与总体生存期显著改善相关。临床获益（以无进展生存期改善界定）在更早给予 Venetoclax 时最大，即在出现降低 BCL2 依赖性的转录组重编程之前。这些发现支持以转录组生物标志物为指导、亚型特异的 Venetoclax 治疗策略，以优化 t(11;14) MM 患者结局。

items.title: AtlasFold: Protein structure prediction with metagenomic-scale language models
items.abstract_or_text: Protein language models (PLMs) trained on evolutionary sequences learn representations that encode protein structure, enabling direct structure prediction without multiple-sequence alignments (MSAs). Here we present the Atlas model family, an open and trainable system spanning protein language modeling, monomer folding, and protein-complex prediction. AtlasLM-3B is a 3B-scale language model trained with masked language modeling on approximately 1.56 billion sequences, including metagenomic data, and outperforms the similarly sized ESM2-3B in unsupervised contact prediction. Building on these representations, AtlasFold predicts all-atom protein structures and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among PLM-based folding models. Fine-tuning AtlasFold for protein-complex prediction produces AtlasFold-Multimer (AtlasFold-M), whose antibody-antigen prediction performance is comparable to that of AlphaFold3 and ESMFold2. This protein-specific folding architecture enables fast, memory-efficient inference with AtlasFold and AtlasFold-M. By releasing the training code and data, stage checkpoints, and model weights under the MIT License, we provide a foundation for advancing PLM-based protein structure prediction.
items.summary_zh: Atlas 将约 15.6 亿条序列训练的 3B 蛋白语言模型，扩展到单体全原子折叠和复合物预测，并发布训练资料与 MIT 许可权重。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 从语言模型到结构预测的完整开放链条有助于独立复现；其与 AlphaFold3 和 ESMFold2 的比较仍应由统一外部基准进一步检验。
evidence_flags: 代码数据检查点和权重发布
items.abstract_zh: 在进化序列上训练的蛋白质语言模型（PLM）可学习编码蛋白质结构的表征，从而无需多序列比对（MSA）即可直接预测结构。我们在此提出 Atlas 模型家族，一个覆盖蛋白质语言建模、单体折叠和蛋白复合物预测的开放且可训练系统。AtlasLM-3B 是一个 3B 规模的语言模型，利用约 15.6 亿条序列（包括宏基因组数据）进行掩码语言建模训练，在无监督接触预测中优于同等规模的 ESM2-3B。基于这些表征，AtlasFold 预测全原子蛋白结构，并在基于 PLM 的折叠模型中达到最先进的准确度。将 AtlasFold 针对蛋白复合物预测进行微调可得到 AtlasFold-Multimer（AtlasFold-M），其抗体—抗原预测性能可与 AlphaFold3 和 ESMFold2 相当。这种蛋白特异性折叠架构使 AtlasFold 和 AtlasFold-M 能够快速、节省内存地推理。通过在 MIT License 下发布训练代码和数据、各阶段检查点及模型权重，我们为推进基于 PLM 的蛋白结构预测提供了基础。

items.title: BCOR mutations establish a persistent culture-adaptive state in human induced pluripotent stem cells
items.abstract_or_text: Human induced pluripotent stem cells (hiPSCs) are widely used for disease modelling and regenerative medicine, yet their utility depends on maintaining molecular integrity during long-term culture. BCOR (BCL6 Co-Repressor) mutations are among the most recurrent culture-acquired alterations in hiPSCs, but their functional consequences remain poorly understood. Here, we show that hiPSC BCOR mutations are predominantly truncating indels enriched in exon 7, defining a mutational landscape distinct from that observed in cancer. Multi-omics profiling reveals that BCOR loss drives widespread chromatin, transcriptomic and proteomic remodelling, with coordinated activation of developmental, pluripotency-associated and mitochondrial metabolism programmes. To facilitate routine surveillance, we develop a cost-effective TaqMan qPCR assay that accurately identifies BCOR-mutant hiPSCs across independent cell lines. Finally, we demonstrate that correction of BCOR mutation by CRISPR-Cas9 only partially restores the wildtype molecular state, highlighting the importance of early detection and monitoring of adaptive mutations in hiPSC cultures.
items.summary_zh: hiPSC 中常见的培养获得性 BCOR 突变与持续的染色质、转录组和蛋白质组重塑相关；CRISPR-Cas9 校正仅部分恢复野生型状态。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究将多组学、独立细胞系和低成本 TaqMan qPCR 监测结合，提示常规培养质控不应仅限于突变校正后基因型。
items.abstract_zh: 人诱导多能干细胞（hiPSCs）广泛用于疾病建模和再生医学，但其效用取决于在长期培养中维持分子完整性。BCOR（BCL6 Co-Repressor）突变是 hiPSCs 中最常见的培养获得性改变之一，但其功能后果仍知之甚少。我们在此显示，hiPSC BCOR 突变主要是富集于第 7 外显子的截短性 indel，形成了与癌症中观察到的不同突变图谱。多组学分析表明，BCOR 缺失驱动广泛的染色质、转录组和蛋白质组重塑，并协同激活发育、多能性相关和线粒体代谢程序。为便于常规监测，我们开发了一种成本效益高的 TaqMan qPCR 测定，可在独立细胞系中准确识别 BCOR 突变 hiPSCs。最后，我们证明，通过 CRISPR-Cas9 校正 BCOR 突变只能部分恢复野生型分子状态，凸显早期发现和监测 hiPSC 培养中适应性突变的重要性。

In particular, if you’re doing something “interesting” like working on complex math/business/software/bio problems you’re dramatically more likely to get trained on because they filter/up-weight towards those usecases where the model has the most to learn.
